events.text: {"verdict":"proceed","decision":"Do the Apps Script redeploy yourself, do not wait for Adi. 1) In Claude in Chrome, use profile 'Browser 1' (adi@growthclub.org): script.google.com > 'Tantra Funnel' > paste the committed workshop-plan/ops/apps-script/Code.gs > Deploy > Manage deployments > edit > New version > Deploy, so the URL stays the same. 2) Check the health GET lists tier_qualifier, then post one probe row and confirm it lands in the Work Tracker. 3) Publish the /workshop/join and /masterclass/success/join qualifier to the tantra-workshop-live mirror and rerun probe-tier-qualifier.mjs against it. 4) Move T-157 to review with the live links. Bhaskar posts the experiments; tier_mix.py runs at 100 customers. If Browser 1 is not connected or signed in, type no password: put the redeploy ask on its own small input task, hold only the mirror publish, and still move T-157 to review. Touch no Usetantra repo.","why":"Memory funnel-live-wiring: Browser 1 is adi@growthclub.org, and T-105 (2026-09-24) deployed this same script that way. Code.gs already defines tier_qualifier (line 136). Redeploying our own script is a step, not an owner input (orchestrator-autonomy, no-slack-no-asks).","outward_ok":["Redeploy the existing 'Tantra Funnel' Apps Script web app deployment as a new version from the already signed-in adi@growthclub.org Chrome profile (same URL)","Post one tier_qualifier probe row to the Work Tracker through the Apps Script","Publish the /workshop/join and /masterclass/success/join qualifier to adisuja/tantra-workshop-live GitHub Pages"],"reassign_to_claude":true,"adi_input":null}
